title: Julianna Joy releases a vibrant prelude to her debut album “GoldStar”
htmlContent: Julianna Joy is making a bold debut with her new single “GoldStar,” the first release from her upcoming album, SOMEBODY CALL THE FIREMEN. This song bursts with energy and confidence, showcasing her as an exciting new talent in the music scene, blending pop sounds with an edgy twist. Produced by Dee Lilly, who has worked with big names like Big Sean and Rejjie Snow, “GoldStar” features a catchy bassline that drives the song forward. Julianna’s captivating voice shines throughout, moving seamlessly between soft and intense moments. The chorus stands out with a strong and moody vibe reminiscent of Billie Eilish. https://open.spotify.com/track/09AYwcfSeomxwlYl60Gmdn “GoldStar” reflects a strong sense of self awareness, almost as if Julianna is challenging listeners while embracing her own strength. It creates a powerful atmosphere and signals the arrival of an artist who is confident in her direction. With her debut album on the way, “GoldStar” sets an exciting tone for what’s to come. Julianna Joy is determined to claim her place in the spotlight. Follow on: Instagram
